title: HIV new infections from 2015
sql:
SELECT
    CAST(STARTYEAR AS INTEGER) AS [year],
    CAST(Numeric AS REAL) AS [value],
    [DIMENSION_CODE] AS [series]
FROM health_indicators
WHERE GHO_CODE = 'HIV_0000000026'
  AND Numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND STARTYEAR IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY [year] ASC, [series] ASC;
